tools.name: trnch_stats
tools.description: Read live public numbers for the last 24 hours: tokens spotted, tokens in the Heat, tokens kept out as High risk, rugs detected, median detection delay in seconds, number of routers and the bot fee in percent. No key needed. Use it first to judge whether TRNCH screening is worth routing through.

tools.name: trnch_register_message
tools.description: Step 1 of 2 to get an API key, no browser. Returns { message }: the exact text your wallet must sign with personal_sign (EIP-191). It is valid for 10 minutes and moves no funds. Then call trnch_register with the signature.

tools.name: trnch_register
tools.description: Step 2 of 2: send the message from trnch_register_message and its signature; returns { key, prefix, wallet } with status 201. The key is shown once, store it. The wallet must hold 10 USDG or 0.004 ETH on Robinhood Chain (402 otherwise); 3 keys max per wallet (409); 400 if the signature or message do

tools.name: trnch_heat
tools.description: Read the live Heat: heat holds tokens screened by TIA and ranked by Heat score; new holds just-spotted tokens not yet screened (higher risk). Each token is an opaque id with rank, Heat score, price, liquidity, volume, price changes and entry time; pass id to trnch_buy or trnch_sell. Returns nextSinc

tools.name: trnch_quote
tools.description: Quote any pair across six routers (KyberSwap, LI.FI, Uniswap, 0x, SushiSwap, 1inch) without building a transaction. Returns the best amount out, already net of the TRNCH fee, and the router. Use it to compare before buying; to trade, call trnch_buy or trnch_sell instead. 409 if a token is not tradab

tools.description: Build a buy in one call: quotes six routers and returns the best route as a transaction for the key's wallet to sign. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: trnch_register_message · Private data: trnch_stats, trnch_register_message, trnch_register, trnch_heat, trnch_quote, trnch_buy, trnch_sell, trnch_confirm · Public sink: trnch_register, trnch_buy, trnch_sell, trnch_confirm.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: trnch_register_message · Private data: trnch_stats, trnch_register_message, trnch_register, trnch_heat, trnch_quote, trnch_buy, trnch_sell, trnch_confirm · Public sink: trnch_register, trnch_buy, trnch_sell, trnch_confirm

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
